newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 10.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 10. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Suharto has asked the House of Representatives to improve some articles in the broadcasting bill. Suharto has yet to sign the bill passed by the House last December.
Central Bank Governor Soedradjad Djiwandono has defended a ban on new loans for land acquisition and development, saying moral suasion had not curbed a rapid increase in property loans.
Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad has said the rupiah is strong and stable and capital inflows remains consistent, giving no evidence to inconsistency in the country's economic fundamentals.

State Secretary Murdiono has said chairman of the ruling Golkar party Harmoko is expected to become the speaker of the House of Representatives. Golkar swept 74 percent of the vote in the May 29 general elections.
